direct_wct: existing OOF benchmark retained; comparison is between complete pathways with different backgrounds
ssrd: training-consistent W m-2 before feature generation
td_constraint: constrained Td = min(unconstrained Td, corrected T)
temperature_dewpoint: T and Td residual correction; 17 elevation-mismatch stations excluded from training but retained in assigned outer prediction folds
training: strict station-grouped five-fold outer OOF with nested station-grouped inner iteration selection
wct: primary standard Celsius WCT at observed T <= 0 C; 0.1 m s-1 numerical floor; no height adjustment
wind: Ralong/Rcross residual models; canonical DEF1 rotation; U/V reconstruction; wind speed from U/V
